question: Who mentioned ecosystem as 'the basic unit in ecology' in 1956?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Francis Evans**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Francis Evans, an eminent ecologist, mentioned the ecosystem as 'the basic unit in ecology' in 1956.
 
• This concept emphasizes the interdependence of organisms within their physical environment.
 
• Evans' definition helped in broadening the understanding of ecological interactions and energy flow within ecosystems.</li
